# disk-usage-mcp

## Overview

FastMCP server wrapping dua-cli and czkawka_cli for disk usage analysis and duplicate detection. Designed for multi-TB media libraries spread across multiple drives. Also parses VirtualDJ / Serato DJ library databases.

## Dependencies

- Python 3.12+
- [dua-cli](https://github.com/Byron/dua-cli) — `winget install Byron.dua-cli`
- [czkawka_cli](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka) — `winget install qarmin.czkawka.cli` (installs as `windows_czkawka_cli`; cargo installs provide `czkawka_cli` — both resolve)
- FastMCP 3.4+
- FastAPI + uvicorn

## Architecture

```
dua-cli ──→ disk-usage-mcp ──→ FastAPI REST ──→ React/Vite frontend (web_sota/)
czkawka_cli ──→   (MCP protocol)    ├── /health + /api/health + /api/status
VDJ/Serato DB ──→                   ├── /api/capabilities, /api/skills[/{name}], /api/logs
                                    ├── /api/setup/status, /api/fleet/apps
                                    ├── /api/scan, /api/duplicates, /api/large-files
                                    ├── /api/snapshot/take, /api/snapshots, /api/snapshot/diff|{file} (GET+DELETE)
                                    ├── /api/llm/discover|providers|models|chat|chat/stream (local only)
                                    ├── POST /api/shutdown, /api/v1/diagnostics, /docs
                                    └── /mcp (MCP streamable HTTP, mounted with path="/")
```

## Dashboard pages

Dashboard (hero+KPIs+onboarding), Drives (treemap), Duplicates, Inbox (snapshots),
Tools (capability runner), Skills, Chat (local LLM, streaming), Logs, Apps (fleet hub),
Settings (LLM providers), Help (onboarding+endpoints). Shortcuts: Ctrl+K/L/H, Ctrl+Scroll
zoom, Ctrl+0 reset. Zoom persists under `tauri-zoom`; chat history (100 cap) and LLM
selection persist in localStorage.

## MCP Tools

All tools return `{"success": bool, "message": str, ...}` plus payload keys.

### scan_path (dua 2.x: `aggregate` text tree parsed to JSON)

```
scan_path(path="D:\\", max_depth=2)
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "data": {"name": "D:", "size": ..., "children": [...]}}
```

### find_large_files

```
find_large_files(path="D:\\", min_size_gb=5.0, limit=50)
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "files": [{"path": "...", "size_gb": 5.2}]}
```

### get_drive_overview

```
get_drive_overview(paths=["C:\\", "D:\\", "E:\\", "F:\\"])
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "drives": [...], "total_bytes": ...}
```

### find_duplicates

```
find_duplicates(search_paths=["D:\\", "E:\\"], min_size_mb=100)
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "duplicates": [{"hash": "...", "size_mb": 500, "files": [...]}]}
```

### disk_usage (portmanteau)

```
disk_usage(operation="scan", path="D:\\", max_depth=2)
disk_usage(operation="tree", path="D:\\Media", max_depth=2)
disk_usage(operation="drive_overview", paths=["C:\\", "D:\\"])
```

### parse_dj_database

```
parse_dj_database()
parse_dj_database(path="C:\\Users\\...\\AppData\\Roaming\\VirtualDJ\\Database.xml")
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "source": "virtualdj"|"serato", "total_tracks": N, "tracks": [...]}
```

### server_help

```
server_help()
server_help(topic="snapshots")
→ {"success": true, "message": "...", "tools": [...], "endpoints": [...]}
```

### show_drives_card / show_duplicates_card (Prefab, app=True)

```
show_drives_card()
show_duplicates_card(search_paths=["D:\\", "E:\\"], min_size_mb=100)
→ ToolResult with text + PrefabApp card
```

## Prompts

- `reclaim-plan(drives, min_size_gb)` — four-step reclamation plan.
- `snapshot-compare(older, newer)` — growth-analysis plan.

## Resources

- `drive://list` — drive letters with usage stats (no scanner needed).
- `skill://disk-usage` — bundled skill text.

## Resources

- `drive://list` — available drive letters with usage stats.

## Best Practices

1. Start with `get_drive_overview` to see drive-level allocation
2. Drill into specific drives with `scan_path` at depth 2-3
3. Use `find_large_files` with min_size_gb=10+ for quick space recovery
4. Run `find_duplicates` across backup drives last (slowest operation)

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| BACKEND_PORT | 11114 | REST API port |
| FRONTEND_PORT | 11115 | Vite dev port |
| MCP_PORT | 11114 | MCP HTTP port (dual transport: set → HTTP, unset → stdio) |
| MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | HTTP bind host |
| DUA_BIN | dua | Path to dua binary |
| CZKAWKA_BIN | czkawka_cli | Path to czkawka binary |

## Ports

- Backend (FastAPI): 11114
- Frontend (Vite dev): 11115
